scripts.cf:sync-config: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .local | Out-Null; Push-Location .local; ..\node_modules\.bin\wrangler.cmd pages download config sub-filter --force; $content = Get-Content wrangler.toml -Raw; $content = [regex]::Replace($content, '(?ms)^\[vars\]\r?\n.*?(?=^\[|\z)', ''); Set-Content wrangler.toml $content; Pop-Location"
